through_hole_cols = 4
chamfer_size = 0.8

base = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness / 2) * Box(base_size, base_size, base_thickness)
base = chamfer(base.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), chamfer_size)

rib_outer = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness + rib_height / 2) * Box(base_size, base_size, rib_height)
rib_inner = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness + rib_height / 2) * Box(base_size - 2 * rib_width, base_size - 2 * rib_width, rib_height)
rib = rib_outer - rib_inner

result = base + rib

pocket = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness + rib_height - pocket_depth / 2) * Box(pocket_width, pocket_width, pocket_depth)
result = result - pocket

blind_hole = Pos(0, 0, base_thickness + rib_height - blind_hole_depth / 2) * Cylinder(blind_hole_diameter / 2, blind_hole_depth)
result = result - blind_hole

spacing_x = (base_size - 2 * rib_width) / (through_hole_cols + 1)
spacing_y = (base_size - 2 * rib_width) / (through_hole_rows + 1)
total_height = base_thickness + rib_height

    for j in range(through_hole_rows):
        x = -base_size / 2 + rib_width + (i + 1) * spacing_x
        y = -base_size / 2 + rib_width + (j + 1) * spacing_y
        hole = Pos(x, y, total_height / 2) * Cylinder(through_hole_diameter / 2, total_height + 2)
